# `annotations-explicit`

**Tool rule** · `warning` · **off by default**, enable it to use it

Require the listed hints to be declared on every imperative tool, so nobody relies on a default they did not choose.

A tool rule judges one tool from its own definition, so it runs everywhere: `lint()`, `lintTools()`, the CLI, the Playwright fixture, the audit crawler and the ESLint plugin.

## Options

| Option   | Default                                |
| -------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `fields` | `["readOnlyHint","consequentialHint"]` |

## Configuring it

```ts
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "annotations-explicit": false } }); // off
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "annotations-explicit": "warning" } }); // change severity
lint(snapshot, {
  rules: { "annotations-explicit": { fields: ["readOnlyHint", "consequentialHint"] } },
});
```

```bash
npx @swissspidy/webmcp-lint tools.json --rule annotations-explicit=off
```

```js
// eslint.config.js
{ rules: { "webmcp/annotations-explicit": "error" } }
```
